splash.title:
Your AI team,
at home.
splash.subtitle: Agents that work on your machine, with the AI subscriptions you already pay for.

account.title: Create your local account
account.subtitle: You sign in to Timon with it. You are its administrator.
account.name: First name
account.nameHint: So your agents call you by your first name.
account.emailHint: Used to sign in. We send it a code to confirm it.
account.privacy: We only collect your email in case you want to reset your password. The account you create stays local.

llm.title:
Choose
your LLM.
llm.subtitle: Timon runs on the AI subscriptions you already have. Never a bill per token.

plan.title: Use my AI subscription
plan.detailAny: The AI tools you already pay for
plan.hint: Timon looked for the AI tools already on this machine.
plan.none: Connect at least one AI to continue.

local.title: Use local models
local.detail: Ollama or oMLX, no subscription, nothing leaves your machine
local.hint: Your agents run on this computer's own models.
local.ollama: Runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Mistral…) locally.
local.omlx: Runs MLX models on Apple Silicon through an OpenAI-compatible server.
local.connect: Once Ollama or oMLX runs, add it as a provider in {settingsPath}.

web.title: Use a web API
web.detail: DeepSeek API, with a key you paste
web.hint: Hosted models, billed per token by the provider.
web.connect: Add it in {settingsPath}: pick the DeepSeek API preset, then paste your key.

llm.legal: By continuing, you accept the {terms} and acknowledge the {privacy}.

profile.title: What brings you here?
profile.subtitle: Timon tunes its defaults and its tour to your answer.

developer.title: I write code
developer.description: Agents that code, review and merge in my repositories.

automation.title: I automate
automation.description: Email, calendar, watch, routines: work that runs on its own.

beginner.title: I'm discovering
beginner.description: I want to understand AI agents, step by step.

dev.title: Coding partner
dev.description: Fixes, reviews and ships in your repositories.

blank.title: Start from scratch
blank.description: A generalist you shape as you go.

interview.title: Let’s set up your automation
interview.subtitle: Five questions, and your agent knows what to do, with what and when.
interview.q1: What do I automate for you?
interview.q4: Before an important action, what do I do?
interview.q5: Where do I let you know?
interview.toolsHint: The ones not connected yet will be offered right after.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.description: Recommended to start: you approve every send or change.

report.title: Act, tell me after
report.description: For routine work: it acts and reports back.

sheet.title: Configure your agent
sheet.subtitle: Every setting stays editable in its profile.
sheet.roleHint: It stays your main agent, the pilot: this only sets what it focuses on.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator / pilot
orchestrator.description: Splits work into tasks and delegates.

code.title: Coder
code.description: Writes and changes your project’s code.

sheet.worktree: One isolated git worktree per code task
sheet.worktreeDetail: It works beside your branch, never in it.

perm.acceptEdits: Accept file edits, ask for the rest
perm.auto: Auto: Timon’s classifier decides, a card only when unsure
perm.bypassPermissions: Allow everything, no checks at all

sheet.bypassWarning: No approval card at all: it can do anything on this machine.
sheet.rulesPlaceholder: E.g. answer in English, never push without asking.

signin.title: Welcome back
signin.subtitle: Timon has a new look. Sign in with your Timon account to continue.

mascot.title: Meet {name}'s mascot
mascot.subtitle: New in this version: every agent has a mascot that shows what it is doing — thinking, working, waiting for you. Dress {name} as you like.
mascot.later: You can change it any time in the agent's Avatar tab.
mascot.failed: The look could not be saved. Try again, or choose “Not now”.

autonomous.title: Your TIMs work on their own
autonomous.body: Give a TIM a mission, a time or a trigger: it picks its skills and tools, remembers what it learns, and reports back once the work is done.

teams.title: Build teams of TIMs
teams.body: One plans, one codes, one reviews: tasks pass from TIM to TIM on the Kanban, and the Multichat lets you talk to all of them at once.

projects.title: Projects with their own TIMs
projects.body: A general assistant knows a little about everything. A project’s TIMs work in that project only, with its own rules and its own memory, and never leave it.

connected.title: Plug in everything else
connected.body: Connectors bring in your mail, calendar and tools; workflows chain the steps; plugins add what is missing, down to the interface.
